title: condorcet: configurable fact-composition engine
description:
Separate shelfmark-style project (working name condorcet) that scores how true a body of facts is by composing evidence with pluggable, JSON-declared composition techniques. org is one fact adapter (lives in dotfiles on org-doc + knowledge-core). Plugs into the dot-4xu6b.8 promotion gate. Design: docs/architecture/fact-composition.md (branch worktree-agent-ae362f2f860298f5b). Decisions pending David: repo split, name, write-back and gate thresholds. No remote repository until David approves.

Mirrors dotfiles epic dot-fact-composition-3a5o6. Org adapter (.3), org write-back (.8) and gate wiring (.9) live in dotfiles and are not mirrored here. Local only; no remote until David approves.
